notes: load of an absent root variable, under the default on_unbound policy - an evaluation option, not part of the ISA (docs/isa.md section 2). Contrast with access.json's access-on-missing-key cases, which push :undefined rather than erroring.

docs/isa.md: empty_stack is an expression-mode rule (section 2) - the one error that belongs to no instruction and therefore carries no source position, only reachable via an empty hand-built instruction list. In statement mode an empty stack at halt is the normal outcome (a well-formed statement program ends each statement with a store or a pop), not this error.

docs/isa.md: insufficient operands is an EvaluationError, not a TypeMismatchError, at every opcode that checks stack depth before checking types - insufficient_operands is the one reason token shared across all of them

docs/isa.md section 5: object_set's target must be a map. Reachable only from a hand-built instruction list - the compiler always emits object_new immediately before object_set - but specified, not undefined. Shares the invalid_stack_value reason with relative_date's non-duration case.
